title: Close Knit · Product
description: How the site is used, never who uses it (docs/product-analytics.md).

list.name: traffic
list.label: Traffic
list.description: Live = people and their assistants; Team = our own checks and visits; Tech = scanners and scripts.
list.query: Live : live, Team : team, Tech : tech

panels.title: People today
panels.description: People (anonymous browser ids) with any web event in the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '1 day'

panels.title: People, 7 days
panels.description: WAU: people in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: People, 30 days
panels.description: MAU: people in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: DAU ÷ MAU
panels.description: DAU ÷ MAU.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '1 day')::float / nullif(count(DISTINCT visitor_id), 0) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Acted ★, 7 days
panels.description: North star: people or MCP conversations that followed a portal link, opened the listing watch or shared a brief.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id)) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name IN ('portal_click', 'watch_open', 'brief_share') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Clicked out, 7 days
panels.description: People or MCP conversations who followed at least one portal link (site and Claude).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id)) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'portal_click' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Use over time (the time picker applies from here)
Active people and sessions per day
panels.description: Distinct anonymous ids and visits (a visit ends after 30 idle minutes) per day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, 1d), count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS "people", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "sessions" FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Acted ★ per week
panels.description: North star by week: people (site) and conversations (Claude) that acted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, 7d), count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id)) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS "site", count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id)) FILTER (WHERE channel <> 'web') AS "Claude / agents" FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name IN ('portal_click', 'watch_open', 'brief_share') AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Funnel: people in the chosen period
panels.description: Happy path: visit → search → find → portal. Each step counts people who did it at least once.

targets.rawSql: WITH people AS ( SELECT visitor_id, bool_or(name = 'page_view') AS visited, bool_or(name IN ('search', 'match_run')) AS searched, bool_or(name = 'area_open' OR (name = 'page_view' AND props->>'path' ~ '^/(area|property|postcode)/')) AS found, bool_or(name = 'portal_click') AS clicked_out, bool_or(name IN ('portal_click', 'watch_open', 'brief_share')) AS acted FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1) SELECT '1 visited' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE visited) AS people FROM people UNION ALL SELECT '2 searched', count(*) FILTER (WHERE searched) FROM people UNION ALL SELECT '3 found an area or home', count(*) FILTER (WHERE found) FROM people UNION ALL SELECT '4 clicked out to a portal', count(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_out) FROM people UNION ALL SELECT '5 acted ★', count(*) FILTER (WHERE acted) FROM people ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Engaged time per visit (median, minutes)
panels.description: Seconds with the tab visible and the reader active in the last 30 s, summed per visit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(day, 1d), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) / 60 AS "median", percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) / 60 AS "p90" FROM (SELECT session_id, min(occurred_at) AS day, sum((props->>'seconds')::numeric) AS seconds FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'engagement' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1) visits GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: By portal and channel
panels.description: listings = homes for sale or to rent; sold = Rightmove sold prices (research, not intent).

targets.rawSql: SELECT channel, props->>'portal' AS portal, props->>'kind' AS kind, props->>'from' AS "from", count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id, id::text)) AS people, count(*) AS clicks FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'portal_click' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY people DESC

panels.title: Areas people clicked out from
panels.description: Area ids are LSOAs (open /area/lsoa/<code> on the site).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(props->>'area', '-') AS area, props->>'outcode' AS district, count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id)) AS people, count(*) AS clicks FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'portal_click' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY people DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Weekly retention (share of each week's new people back later)
panels.description: A home search lasts weeks to months: someone who clicked out and left may be a success, not churn.

targets.rawSql: WITH firsts AS ( SELECT visitor_id, date_trunc('week', min(occurred_at)) AS cohort FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT visitor_id, date_trunc('week', occurred_at) AS week FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT f.cohort::date AS "week of", count(DISTINCT f.visitor_id) AS "new people", round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT w.visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE w.week = f.cohort + interval '1 week') / count(DISTINCT f.visitor_id)) AS "week 1 %", round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT w.visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE w.week = f.cohort + interval '2 weeks') / count(DISTINCT f.visitor_id)) AS "week 2 %", round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT w.visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE w.week = f.cohort + interval '4 weeks') / count(DISTINCT f.visitor_id)) AS "week 4 %" FROM firsts f JOIN weeks w USING (visitor_id) WHERE f.cohort >= now() - interval '12 weeks' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Where people come from
panels.description: invite, a utm_source, or the referring site's name.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(props->>'source', 'direct') AS source, count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS people FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'page_view' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY people DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: By screen width: mobile < 640 px, tablet < 1024 px.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(device, 'unknown') AS device, count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS people FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY people DESC

panels.title: Searches that found nothing
panels.description: Words as typed; a postcode keeps its district; anything else with digits is not kept.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'query' AS query, count(*) AS times FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'search_empty' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Search quality
panels.description: Zero-result rates show where search or matching lets people down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'search') AS "results chosen", count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'search_empty') AS "searches with nothing", count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'match_run') AS "area matches", count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'match_run' AND (props->>'results')::int = 0) AS "matches with no area" FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Searches by kind
panels.description: What people pick from the search box: a home, a postcode page, an area level.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'kind' AS kind, count(*) AS chosen FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'search' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY chosen DESC

panels.title: Searches people opted to share (budget bands)
panels.description: Only from people who ticked 'Share redacted usage data' under Your search.

targets.rawSql: SELECT market, budget_band AS "budget up to", bedrooms, count(*) AS searches FROM profile_analytics_event WHERE traffic IN ($traffic) AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY searches DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Pages that failed to load
panels.description: The digest matches the server's log line for the same failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'path' AS path, props->>'digest' AS digest, count(*) AS times, max(occurred_at) AS "last" FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'client_error' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 20
